arxiv-1709-08908.title: Search for new phenomena in final states with two opposite-charge, same-flavor leptons, jets, and missing transverse momentum in pp collisions at s = 13 ​ \TeV \sqrt{s}=13\TeV
arxiv-1709-08908.description: Abstract Search results are presented for physics beyond the standard model in final states with two opposite-charge, same-flavor leptons, jets, and missing transverse momentum. The data sample corresponds to an integrated luminosity of 35.9 \fbinv of proton-proton collisions at s = 13 ​ \TeV \sqrt{s}=13\TeV collected with the CMS detector at the LHC in 2016.

arxiv-2108-13425.title: Partition function of the Levin-Wen model
arxiv-2108-13425.creator: Julien Vidal
arxiv-2108-13425.description: Abstract Using a description of the Levin-Wen model excitations in terms of Wilson lines, we compute the degeneracy of the energy levels for any input anyon theory and for any trivalent graph embedded on any (orientable) compact surface. This result allows one to obtain the finite-size and finite-temperature partition function and to show that there are no thermal phase transitions.

arxiv-2307-07182.title: Algebraic Modification of the Method of Undetermined Coefficients For Solving Nonhomogeneous Linear Difference Equations
arxiv-2307-07182.creator: Timofey Lomonosov
arxiv-2307-07182.description: Abstract In this paper, an algebraic modification of the method of undetermined coefficients for solving nonhomogeneous linear stationary difference equations for quasipolynomial right-hand sides is proposed. Although the classical method of undetermined coefficients is well-known in both differential equations and difference equations case, its application in the difference equations case is severely limited.

arxiv-2310-09900.title: Algebra and combinatorics of the Brion map on generalized permutahedra
arxiv-2310-09900.creator: Alvaro Cornejo, Mariel Supina
arxiv-2310-09900.description: Abstract The Brion morphism maps a generalized permutahedron to a collection of posets associated to its vertices. We compute this map explicitly for the Hopf monoids of permutahedra, associahedra, and orbit polytopes, and we explore the dual Brion map of the primitive Lie monoids associated to these three Hopf monoids.

arxiv-2312-09951.title: On the Alon-Tarsi number of some line and total graphs
arxiv-2312-09951.creator: Prajnanaswaroopa S
arxiv-2312-09951.description: Abstract Abstract This work discusses the Alon-Tarsi number of line graphs and total graphs. In addition, we also discuss the Alon-Tarsi number of some Erdos-Faber-Lovasz (EFL) graphs. Introduction The Combinatorial Nullstellensatz [ 5 ] has become very popular in solving combinatorial as well as algebraic and number-theoretic problems of late.

arxiv-2312-13949.title: Non-Termination in Term Rewriting and Logic Programming
arxiv-2312-13949.creator: Étienne Payet 0000-0002-3519-025X
arxiv-2312-13949.description: Abstract In this paper, we define two particular forms of non-termination, namely loops and binary chains , in an abstract framework that encompasses term rewriting and logic programming. The definition of loops relies on the notion of compatibility of binary relations. We also present a syntactic criterion for the detection of a special case of binary chains.

arxiv-2401-00797.title: Curriculum-scheduled Knowledge Distillation from Multiple Pre-trained Teachers for Multi-domain Sequential Recommendation
arxiv-2401-00797.creator: Wenqi Sun, Ruobing Xie, Junjie Zhang, Wayne Xin Zhao, Leyu Lin, Ji-Rong Wen
arxiv-2401-00797.description: Abstract Pre-trained recommendation models (PRMs) have received increasing interest recently. However, their intrinsically heterogeneous model structure, huge model size and computation cost hinder their adoptions in practical recommender systems. Hence, it is highly essential to explore how to use different pre-trained recommendation models efficiently in real-world systems.

arxiv-2401-05769.title: Fate of 𝜿 \kappa -Minkowski space-time in non-relativistic (Galilean) and ultra-relativistic (Carrollian) regimes Bulk of this work was completed here
arxiv-2401-05769.creator: Deeponjit Bose, Anwesha Chakraborty, Biswajit Chakraborty
arxiv-2401-05769.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Deeponjit Bose, Anwesha Chakraborty, Biswajit Chakraborty. We present an algebraic and kinematical analysis of non-commutative κ \kappa -Minkowski spaces within Galilean (non-relativistic) and Carrollian (ultra-relativistic) regimes. Utilizing the theory of Wigner-Inönu contractions, we begin with a brief review of how one can apply these contractions to the well-known Poincaré algebra, yielding the corresponding Galilean and Carrollian algebras as c → ∞ c\to\infty and c → 0 c\to 0 , respectively.

arxiv-2403-10949.title: SelfIE : Self-Interpretation of Large Language Model Embeddings
arxiv-2403-10949.creator: Haozhe Chen, Carl Vondrick, Chengzhi Mao
arxiv-2403-10949.description: Abstract How do large language models (LLMs) obtain their answers? The ability to explain and control an LLM’s reasoning process is key for reliability, transparency, and future model developments. We propose SelfIE (Self-Interpretation of Embeddings), a framework that enables LLMs to interpret their own embeddings in natural language by leveraging their ability to respond to inquiries about a given passage.

arxiv-2404-02071.title: Granular aqueous suspensions with controlled inter-particular friction and adhesion
arxiv-2404-02071.creator: Lily Blaiset, Bruno Bresson, Ludovic Olanier, Élisabeth Guazzelli, Matthieu Roché, Nicolas Sanson
arxiv-2404-02071.description: Abstract We present a simple route to obtain large quantities of suspensions of non-Brownian particles with stimuli -responsive surface properties to study the relation between their flow and interparticle interactions. We perform an alkaline hydrolysis reaction on poly(methyl methacrylate) (PMMA) particles to obtain poly(sodium methacrylate) (PMAA-Na) particles.

arxiv-2407-14314.title: EmoCAM: Toward Understanding What Drives CNN-based Emotion Recognition
arxiv-2407-14314.creator: Youssef Doulfoukar*, Laurent Mertens*, Joost Vennekens
arxiv-2407-14314.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Youssef Doulfoukar*, Laurent Mertens*, Joost Vennekens. Convolutional Neural Networks are particularly suited for image analysis tasks, such as Image Classification, Object Recognition or Image Segmentation. arxiv-2505-01391.title: Learning and Transferring Physical Models through Derivatives
arxiv-2505-01391.creator: Alessandro Trenta, Andrea Cossu, Davide Bacciu
arxiv-2505-01391.description: Abstract We propose Derivative Learning ( DERL ), a supervised approach that models physical systems by learning their partial derivatives. We also leverage DERL to build physical models incrementally, by designing a distillation protocol that effectively transfers knowledge from a pre-trained to a student model.

arxiv-2507-21135.title: Quantum Geometry of Data
arxiv-2507-21135.creator: Alexander G. Abanov, Luca Candelori, Harold C. Steinacker, Martin T. Wells, Jerome R. Busemeyer, Cameron J. Hogan, Vahagn Kirakosyan, Nicola Marzari, Sunil Pinnamaneni, Dario Villani, Mengjia Xu, Kharen Musaelian
arxiv-2507-21135.description: Abstract We demonstrate how Quantum Cognition Machine Learning (QCML) encodes data as quantum geometry. In QCML, features of the data are represented by learned Hermitian matrices, and data points are mapped to states in Hilbert space. The quantum geometry description endows the dataset with rich geometric and topological structure—including intrinsic dimension, quantum metric, and Berry curvature—derived directly from the data.

pmc-10557232.title: Clinical features, epidemiology, and treatment of Shwachman-Diamond syndrome: a systematic review
pmc-10557232.creator: Xue Han, Shuanglong Lu, Changjuan Gu, Zhuli Bian, Xiaotian Xie, Xiaohong Qiao
pmc-10557232.description: BackgroundShwachman-Diamond syndrome (SDS) is an autosomal recessive disease which results in inherited bone marrow failure (IBMF) and is characterized by exocrine pancreatic dysfunction and diverse clinical phenotypes. In the present study, we reviewed the internationally published reports on SDS patients, in order to summarize the clinical features, epidemiology, and treatment of SDS.

pmc-10685696.title: Access to Rehabilitation After Hospitalization for Traumatic Brain Injury: A National Longitudinal Cohort Study in Sweden
pmc-10685696.creator: Andrea Klang, Yasmina Molero, Paul Lichtenstein, Henrik Larsson, Brian Matthew D’Onofrio, Niklas Marklund, Christian Oldenburg, Elham Rostami
pmc-10685696.description: BackgroundRehabilitation is suggested to improve outcomes following traumatic brain injury (TBI), however, the extent of access to rehabilitation among TBI patients remains unclear.ObjectiveTo examine the level of access to rehabilitation after TBI, and its association with health and sociodemographic factors.MethodWe conducted a longitudinal cohort study using Swedish nationwide healthcare and sociodemographic registers.

pmc-10704681.title: ∆4-3-oxo-5β-reductase deficiency: favorable outcome in 16 patients treated with cholic acid
pmc-10704681.creator: Antoine Gardin, Mathias Ruiz, Jan Beime, Mara Cananzi, Margarete Rathert, Barbara Rohmer, Enke Grabhorn, Marion Almes, Veena Logarajah, Luis Peña-Quintana, Thomas Casswall, Amaria Darmellah-Remil, Ana Reyes-Domínguez, Emna Barkaoui, Loreto Hierro, Carolina Baquero-Montoya, Ulrich Baumann, Björn Fisc
pmc-10704681.description: BackgroundOral cholic acid therapy is an effective therapy in children with primary bile acid synthesis deficiencies. Most reported patients with this treatment have 3β-hydroxy-Δ5-C27-steroid oxidoreductase deficiency. The aim of the study was the evaluation of cholic acid therapy in a cohort of patients with the rarer Δ4-3-oxosteroid 5β-reductase (Δ4-3-oxo-R) deficiency.

pmc-11325025.title: Species–specific circuitry of double cone photoreceptors in two avian retinas
pmc-11325025.creator: Anja Günther, Silke Haverkamp, Stephan Irsen, Paul V. Watkins, Karin Dedek, Henrik Mouritsen, Kevin L. Briggman
pmc-11325025.description: In most avian retinas, double cones (consisting of a principal and accessory member) outnumber other photoreceptor types and have been associated with various functions, such as encoding luminance, sensing polarized light, and magnetoreception. However, their down-stream circuitry is poorly understood, particularly across bird species. Analysing species differences is important to understand changes in circuitry driven by ecological adaptations.

pmc-11422043.title: Investigating the mildew and yeast in the bakeries of Abhar City, Iran
pmc-11422043.creator: Giti Kashi
pmc-11422043.description: The presence of mold and yeast in bread leads to contamination in bread. Cancer and estrogenic abnormalities in humans are among the diseases caused by fungal and mold mycotoxins in bread.Bread production waste was estimated at about 30 % in Iran country.

pmc-11683655.title: Influence of the Enterovirus 71 Vaccine and the COVID-19 Pandemic on Hand, Foot, and Mouth Disease in China Based on Counterfactual Models: Observational Study
pmc-11683655.creator: Jia Nie, Tian Huang, Yuhong Sun, Zutong Peng, Wenlong Dong, Jiancheng Chen, Di Zheng, Fuyin Guo, Wenhui Shi, Yuewei Ling, Weijia Zhao, Haijun Yang, Tiejun Shui, Xiangyu Yan
pmc-11683655.description: BackgroundHand, foot, and mouth disease (HFMD) is a highly contagious viral illness. Understanding the long-term trends of HFMD incidence and its epidemic characteristics under the circumstances of the enterovirus 71 (EV71) vaccination program and the outbreak of COVID-19 is crucial for effective disease surveillance and control.

pmc-11861158.title: Catchment area rates of involuntary care and subsequent patient morbidity and mortality in Norway
pmc-11861158.creator: O Nyttingnes
pmc-11861158.description: IntroductionMental health legislation allows for involuntary care of patients with severe mental disorders, assuming it improves health and reduces risk. Professionals have warned against potentially adverse effects of recent initiatives to heighten involuntary care threshold, such as CRPD and national coercion-reduction strategies. We have not found that the impact of high thresholds for involuntary care have been studied.

pmc-13130827.title: Primary Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Breast: A Case Report and Comprehensive Literature Review
pmc-13130827.creator: Fawad Talat, Hoor Ali, Abdul Subhan Talpur, Obuli Srinivasan Gurunathan, Tzvetan Kozarski, Mansi Kallem, Madhuri Yalamanchili
pmc-13130827.description: Primary squamous cell carcinoma (SCC) of the breast is one of the rarest forms of metaplastic breast carcinoma. It is typically triple-negative, high-grade, and is associated with aggressive clinical behavior. As it is an extremely rare condition, there is no standardized treatment protocol.

pmc-13408658.title: When Usability Isn’t Enough: Understanding Rural Challenges in Respiratory Virus Test Interpretation
pmc-13408658.creator: Jennifer K. Frediani, Cheryl L. Stone, Sarah Farmer, Amanda Peagler, Richard Parsons, Adrianna L. Westbrook, Laura M. Johnson, Mark A. Griffiths, Wilbur A. Lam, Greg S. Martin
pmc-13408658.description: Background/Objectives: This study aimed to evaluate the usability and comprehension of at-home respiratory diagnostic tests for COVID-19 and influenza among rural and urban populations in Georgia. It sought to identify disparities in test interpretation and outcomes that could inform public health interventions tailored to underserved communities.

pmc-13455083.title: Evaluating the impact of inflammatory bowel disease on mental health during pregnancy: a retrospective survey study
pmc-13455083.creator: Nikhila Butani, Serena Perera, Varun Srikanth, Vrati Mehra, Katie O’Connor, Karren Xiao, Yash Patel, Cynthia Maxwell, Nadia Griller, Talia Zenlea, Vithyaa Premjeyanth, Simone Vigod, Vivian Huang
pmc-13455083.description: BackgroundIndividuals with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) experience mental health disorders at rates 1.5-2 times higher than the general population. Many are affected during major life stages such as pregnancy, yet data on how IBD influences anxiety and depression in pregnancy remain limited.

pmc-13688779.title: lncRNA ZNF667-AS1 suppresses hepatitis B virus-related hepatocellular carcinoma by regulating miR-210-3p to upregulate CPEB2
pmc-13688779.creator: Huimin Cong, Guobing Zhu, Yingzhou Xu, Linlin Wu, Hongfang Gu, Chunyan Dai
pmc-13688779.description: BackgroundTo explore the biological functions, clinical significance, and regulatory mechanism of long non-coding RNA (lncRNA) ZNF667-AS1 in hepatitis B virus (HBV)-related hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC).MethodsOne hundred and seven patients with HBV-related HCC, one hundred and five patients with chronic hepatitis B (CHB) and one hundred and five healthy controls were enrolled in this study.
